transmission_mechanism.explanation: The minutes, released on 22 Aug 2026, highlighted a hawkish tone, which market participants typically read as a cue that the RBI may raise rates. If rates rise, loan interest rates for businesses and consumers increase, reducing disposable income and profit margins. The effect on earnings or prices may appear after a lag of a few weeks as new loan terms take effect. This chain assumes the RBI follows through on the hawkish signal, which is not confirmed in the article.
